main.description: Every gist an account holds, newest first: its dev.knotless.repo records whose kind is gist, as the appview has indexed them while a feed keeps it current, else as its PDS lists them. Each with the names of the files at its root, read from the appview's mirror of it. No authentication; responses are not personalized.
